VC-9 INCONCLUSIVE. I did not write the verdict file, so the review's evidence check will find none. The reason is below.

What I read: `setChatInputValue` in `src/commands/SlashAutocomplete.tsx:29-33` calls the native `HTMLInputElement.prototype.value` setter and then dispatches a bubbling `input` Event. `ChatWidget.tsx:337-341` calls it in `onTurnFailed` when the input is empty.

Why I stopped: the claim depends on how react-chatbot-kit's `Chat` component reads the input. The item has no `dependency_sources`. A Glob of `node_modules/react-chatbot-kit/**` found no files, and a Glob for `react-chatbot-kit*` in the head view found none either. I did not read the kit's source, so I can't confirm that its React `onChange` fires on the dispatched event, that its state holds the refilled text, or that send then submits it.

Missing evidence: the react-chatbot-kit source, specifically the `Chat` component's input `onChange` and send handling.
